Linefact Outdoor – Kartendaten / Map data

© OpenStreetMap contributors (OpenStreetMap-Mitwirkende)
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

The map data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

Linefact Outdoor uses the Protomaps Basemap (a Produced Work of OpenStreetMap,
ODbL) including water and land polygons from osmdata.openstreetmap.de (ODbL,
produced with osmcoastline by Jochen Topf and contributors) and Natural Earth
(public domain). Map design: own Linefact style based on @protomaps/basemaps
(BSD-3-Clause, design CC0). Linefact Outdoor is not affiliated with Protomaps.
